scientific_integrity: All-size statements are proved in the accompanying text; finite executable tests independently corroborate specific examples and are not substituted for proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only incoming-neighbor synchronous NOR on directed Kautz word graphs with degree at least two is covered.
Exact probability laws assume independent Bernoulli inputs with one common parameter; the limit fixes the degree and input bias.
The 2013 closely related special-digraph journal article was not available in full; historical equivalence cannot be excluded.
No independent external scientific audit has been performed.
title: Frozen alphabet phases and exact first-entry laws for NOR dynamics on Kautz digraphs
